g.text: OULAD_BBB: changes in frozen-model group-versus-complement gaps
Descriptive held-out audits, separate from monitored records. Gap = group rate minus its complement; change = later gap minus baseline gap. Positive
means the signed gap increased, not necessarily harm. Gray × includes unsupported denominators and the aggregate, which has no complement. Each
relevant denominator must be ≥20. CSV includes baseline/current rates, gaps, numerators and denominators; no causal or population inference.
